$comment: The one place the project says who it is. Everything that names the project, its home, its docs, or its contact reads this file or is checked against it (npm run check:project-facts). Change a value here and the check names every copy that has to follow.
name: switchboard
description: Mention it in Slack and an agent reviews the PR, ships the fix, or answers the question — on the model you choose, with its tools running where you decide.

commands.$comment: What each root npm script does and when to run it — the source of the Commands table in AGENTS.md (npm run agents:gen). A script without an entry fails agents:check, so a new script cannot ship undocumented.

verify.does: Runs every CI check across the repo and workspaces.
verify.when: Local sessions before review; CI selects affected checks on each push.

verify:root.does: The bot package's gate: consistency checks, typecheck, lint, format, tests, dist.

check:consistency.does: The sub-second checks that generated and declared things equal the code, this table included.
check:consistency.when: After touching a generated or declared artifact; one CI leg.

test.does: The whole vitest suite from one entry, after `deploy:gen`.
test.when: Local sessions before pushing; CI runs it for relevant changes.

typecheck.does: TypeScript over the bot and its scripts, no emit.
typecheck.when: After type-level changes; `verify:root` runs it. A pipeline agent scopes it to the touched tsconfig.

lint.when: `npm run fix` repairs what it can.

format.does: Prettier over the whole tree (not Markdown).

fix.does: Regenerates every generated artifact and repairs lint and formatting.

build.when: `check:dist` and the Docker image run it; rarely by hand.

dev.does: Runs the bot from source with tsx.
dev.when: Local development against a real Slack app.

cli.does: The operator CLI over the command registry (`-- <group> <verb> …`), plus `ask` to drive the full pipeline without Slack.
cli.when: Smoke tests, deploys, config, run history.

resident:archive.does: Captures a bounded retained resident tree through the old route and verifies an offline restore.
resident:archive.when: Reviewed disposable-resident rehearsal with exact binding and Worker build receipts.

ci:gate.does: Reads the `needs` context of a CI fan-out and accepts only successful legs or an explicitly planned skip.
ci:gate.when: CI only — the `bot`, `workers` and `image` gate jobs.

ci:plan.does: Selects checks and builds from the full diff; uncertainty runs all.

check:lockfile.does: Native packages carry Linux x64 and macOS arm64 variants; records mirror their `package.json`.
check:lockfile.when: After a manifest edit or `npm install`; failures name the fix.

check:sandbox-pair.does: Each Worker on the `cloudflare/sandbox` image pins `@cloudflare/sandbox` to exactly its Dockerfile tag.
check:sandbox-pair.when: After bumping either half of a pair.

check:pr-title.does: Judges one PR title as the changelog line: grammar, type, scope, `!`.
check:pr-title.when: `-- "feat(scope): …"` before opening a PR; CI's `title` check.

pr-title:gen.does: Writes the title gate's types and scopes from the release config and the code map.

pr-title:check.does: The committed title vocabulary equals its two sources.

check:dist.does: Builds, then proves the compiled entry points and the web bundle the image needs exist.

check:site.does: Every page the dashboard links to is in the built site, and its home page reads `displayName`.
check:site.when: After a docs change; part of `verify`.

check:image.when: After touching a Dockerfile; needs Docker. One CI leg per image.

check:project-facts.does: Checks project names, URLs, contact and package metadata against `project.json`.
check:project-facts.when: After project or community file changes; part of `check:consistency`.

check:registry-drift.does: Every example-config model ref still resolves against the pinned pi registry.
check:registry-drift.when: After a pi bump; part of `check:consistency`.

skills:sync.when: After changing the manifest; part of `fix`.

skills:check.does: The vendored skills match the manifest byte for byte.

licenses:check.does: Every production dependency's license is on the allowlist.

check:deps-drift.does: Installed node_modules match the lockfile: drift fails by name.

docs:gen.does: Writes the generated regions of the reference docs from the command registry.
docs:gen.when: After changing a command, flag, route, or config key; part of `fix`.

docs:check.does: The generated doc regions equal what the code would generate.

specs:check.does: Checks spec proofs, headers and decision boundaries.

specs:coverage.does: Maps changed paths to specs and lists gaps.
specs:coverage.when: Before review: `-- --changed origin/main...HEAD`; `-- --require` fails on gaps.

decisions:check.does: Checks decision and plan status, succession and amendment rules.
decisions:check.when: Part of `check:consistency`; supersede or amend failed records.

hygiene:check.does: The public tree's imprint (company, people, trackers, plan ids, ids, dates) equals the recorded list, which only shrinks.
hygiene:check.when: Part of `check:consistency`. New hit: rewrite the line or allow it by name.

hygiene:gen.does: Records the tree's remaining imprint after a scrub; refuses growth unless `-- --force`.
hygiene:gen.when: Part of `fix`; new imprint fails it like `hygiene:check`.

vocabulary:check.does: No internal word prints on a user surface; the baseline only shrinks.
vocabulary:check.when: Part of `check:consistency`; a hit is rewritten in the user's nouns.

vocabulary:gen.does: Records the remaining internal words; refuses growth unless `-- --force`.

user-message:check.when: Part of `check:consistency`; the baseline only shrinks.

agents:gen.does: Writes the Commands table in AGENTS.md from `package.json` and this file.
agents:gen.when: After adding or changing a script; part of `fix`.

agents:check.does: AGENTS.md is under its size budget, its Commands table is current, and every root script is described here.

clock:gen.does: Regenerates both clock allowlists: wall-clock reads (empty) and duration literals outside `src/core/budgets.ts`.

clock:check.does: No production file reads the wall clock directly or gained a duration literal outside `src/core/budgets.ts`; both allowlists match the tree.

docs:changed.does: Reports whether HEAD^ changed a docs site input.

deploy:gen.does: Renders each Worker's gitignored `wrangler.jsonc` from its template and the profile in force.
deploy:gen.when: `test`, each Worker's `verify` and `deploy all` run it; by hand before `wrangler dev`.

deploy:check.when: When one looks hand-edited; change the template.

deploy:targets.does: Which Workers a PR's diff would deploy, as a job summary; on the release PR, a sticky comment.

docs:dev.does: Serves the docs site locally with live reload.

docs:build.when: Rarely by hand; `verify -w docs` and the docs Worker's deploy run it.

web:preview.does: Serves the dashboard bundle over fixtures for a visual check.

screenshots:gen.does: Renders changed dashboard captures in both themes and records input hashes.
screenshots:gen.when: After a `web/` or fixture change; needs Chromium.

screenshots:check.does: Each surface's inputs still hash to what its screenshots were rendered from — no browser.

load.does: Load harness for infrastructure and route checks.

smoke:ingress.does: Checks three deployment capability families and writes an acceptance receipt; --check validates setup without network.
smoke:ingress.when: Explicitly configured disposable smoke scope; release acceptance.
